card.title: Traceability record

steps.onTheWay: The brigade is on the way
steps.anchoring: Waiting for the transaction to confirm
steps.sealed: Registered and sealed with a hash

card.itemsHint: Delivered / planned. Less than planned can be delivered, never more.

verify.title: Delivery verification
verify.hint: Recomputes the hash from the current data and files and compares it with the one on the blockchain.
verify.ok: Intact: the record matches the blockchain.
verify.mismatch: Mismatch: the record changed after it was anchored.
verify.notFound: The delivery is not registered yet.
verify.unavailable: The blockchain is not answering right now. Try again in a few minutes.

card.publicHint: Public verification link: anyone can check the delivery without signing in.

formats.pdfHint: Backend report with each delivery's hash, transaction and verification status.
formats.pdfDeliveryHint: Report of the delivery's zone on the delivery day: if there were several deliveries that day, all are included.
formats.xlsxHint: One row per delivery, ready to filter and sort.
formats.xlsxDeliveryHint: Only this delivery: summary, resources and evidence in separate sheets.

export.rangeHint: Both days are included. Leave it empty to export the whole period.

errors.rangeInvalid: The end date cannot be before the start date.
errors.noDeliveries: There are no deliveries in that date range.
errors.deliveryRequired: The delivery has not loaded yet. Try again.
errors.notRegistered: The delivery is not registered yet: the PDF will be available once it is delivered.
